population: Admissible primes p=1mod6 in two equal-width high bands, excluding the conservative prior profile inventory.

sampling.algorithm: SHA256(seed32 || little_endian_uint64_counter), exact256-bit rejection before modulo, deterministic qualified primality and cubic class, reject exclusions and duplicates, first quota in each stratum.
sampling.seed_label: Rabung small-prime neutrality transport v1, 2026-10-02 morning
sampling.strata: Band1 cube,band1 noncube,band2 cube,band2 noncube; independent SRS without replacement in each stratum.

training: Only the two already closed million-prime studies below2^33; their primary tests remain unchanged.
limits: Finite-range predictive comparison and associations; no universal Poisson/intensity law, no causal proof, no exhaustive scan and no global-record/priority certificate.
reproduction_scope: The exact accepted lists are included. Sampler traces and the earlier exclusion inventory are not bundled; do not claim this subset regenerates the sampling process from seeds alone.
